objective_summary.value: The research aimed to develop and validate unsteady flamelet generated manifold (UFGM) modeling techniques for concurrent flame spread in microgravity using BASS experiments. Its goal was to enable accurate prediction of flammability limits for spacecraft materials to support spacecraft fire safety.
objective_summary.quote: The objective of this research was to develop and validate new flamelet generated manifold (FGM) modeling techniques for concurrent flame spread in microgravity.
